rows.en: －　Hangar　－＝－　Natsuno talks to an engineer　－
＊Engineer＊＠０６９＿００１Why go out of your way to￥recommend an older model?
＊Natsuno＊＠０６９＿００２I'm not saying the newest￥model is bad or anything.￥It's just...
＊Natsuno＊＠０６９＿００３With Workers, how used to the￥machine the pilot is makes more￥difference than you'd think.
＊Natsuno＊＠０６９＿００４So I don't think newer is￥always better.
＊Engineer＊＠０６９＿００５You may have a point there.
＊Natsuno＊＠０６９＿００６Personally, I think...＝＠０６９＿００７the D-208R is the better choice￥long-term. A good pilot can get￥nearly twice the performance.
＊Engineer＊＠０６９＿００８Understood. I'll pass that￥along to my superiors as input￥for the procurement decision.
＊Natsuno＊＠０６９＿００９Great. Thanks so much.
What was that about?
Is he an engineer here?
What was that about?
Is he an engineer here?
＊Natsuno＊＠０６９＿０１０Huh?!￥Oh, it's you!
＊Natsuno＊＠０６９＿０１１We were talking about the￥new Workers they're bringing in.
＊Natsuno＊＠０６９＿０１２Oh... yeah, that's right.￥We were talking about the new￥Workers they're bringing in.
＊Natsuno＊＠０６９＿０１３But it sounds like they still￥haven't decided which model.
＊Natsuno＊＠０６９＿０１４So I was giving them￥my two cents.
You really know a lot!
Leave it to the experts.
You really know a lot!
Leave it to the experts.
＊Natsuno＊＠０６９＿０１５You think so?￥When you ride them every day,￥you just pick it up.
＊Natsuno＊＠０６９＿０１６I love Workers, so somehow I￥never get bored, no matter￥how long I'm in one!
＊Natsuno＊＠０６９＿０１７I know, I know. But when it￥comes to Workers, I just can't￥help butting in.
＊Natsuno＊＠０６９＿０１８You know, I really, really￥love piloting Workers.
＊Natsuno＊＠０６９＿０１９So even during training, I end￥up wandering over to the￥Hangar, but...
＊Natsuno＊＠０６９＿０２０Really, I should work harder￥at the other training too.
But I get how you feel.
The rest matters too.
But I get how you feel.
The rest matters too.
＊Natsuno＊＠０６９＿０２１Oh, really?￥I'm so happy you understand!
＊Natsuno＊＠０６９＿０２２Hey, I know I can count on you,￥so... can I ask you a favor?
＊Natsuno＊＠０６９＿０２３You're right.
＊Natsuno＊＠０６９＿０２４I know that, but...￥here I am again, aren't I?
＊Natsuno＊＠０６９＿０２５But Workers are something￥special to me.

＊Natsuno＊＠０６９＿０２６My training Worker is a￥custom build, but...＝＠０６９＿０２７no matter how many times they￥adjust the right arm, it never￥feels quite right.＝＠０６９＿０２８So I figured I'd just do it￥myself, but it looks like I￥can't manage it alone.
＊Natsuno＊＠０６９＿０２９If you don't mind,￥could you give me a hand?
I'll help however I can.
Sounds like a pain.
I'll help however I can.
Sounds like a pain.
＊Natsuno＊＠０６９＿０３０Really?￥Thank you!!
＊Natsuno＊＠０６９＿０３１It's fine! It's fine!!￥It's really easy, I promise!
＊Natsuno＊＠０６９＿０３２Please!!
＊Natsuno＊＠０７０＿００１Okay, I'll get in the Worker￥and line up the arm mount...
＊Natsuno＊＠０７０＿００２When I give the signal, can you￥open up the joint coupling?
＊Natsuno＊＠０７０＿００３No need to rush. Thanks!
＊Natsuno＊＠０７０＿００４Now!!
＊Natsuno＊＠０７０＿００５It's in!＝＠０７０＿００６Okay!!￥Perfect!!
＊Natsuno＊＠０７０＿００７Whew. Thanks!
＊Natsuno＊＠０７０＿００８Sorry for taking up￥your time!
＊Natsuno＊＠０７０＿００９I'd been racking my brain￥trying to figure out how to￥do it by myself...
You could've just asked.
Teamwork made it quick.
You could've just asked.
Teamwork made it quick.
＊Natsuno＊＠０７０＿０１０But everyone's probably busy.＝＠０７０＿０１１Besides, around this time,￥people are worn out from￥training...
＊Natsuno＊＠０７０＿０１２Listen to me, saying that after￥I just asked you for help!￥What am I even talking about?
＊Natsuno＊＠０７０＿０１３I know, right?￥With your help, we got it￥on the first try!!
＊Natsuno＊＠０７０＿０１４You know, for someone about my￥sister's age, you're really￥calm and collected.
＊Natsuno＊＠０７０＿０１５Oh, sorry, I didn't mean it￥in a bad way! I just thought￥you seemed really mature.
＊Natsuno＊＠０７０＿０１６Thanks so much for today.￥You really helped me out!
＊Natsuno＊＠０７０＿０１７If you ever need help￥with anything,￥just come talk to me.
＊Natsuno＊＠０７０＿０１８If it's Worker-related,￥I might be of some use.
＊Natsuno＊＠０７０＿０１９See you later!
